summary: Flaws allowing users to act outside their intended permissions.
detection_strategy: Enumerate endpoints, test access with unauthenticated tokens, check direct object references (IDOR).
remediation: Enforce role-based access control (RBAC) server-side, deny by default, disable directory listings.

summary: Exposure of sensitive data due to weak or missing encryption in transit and at rest.
detection_strategy: Inspect TLS cipher suites, enforce HTTPS, check HSTS headers, verify hashing algorithms (bcrypt/argon2 vs md5/sha1).
remediation: Use TLS 1.3, strong cipher suites, disable legacy protocols, enforce strict HSTS and encryption.

summary: Untrusted data sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query (SQL, OS, LDAP).
detection_strategy: Non-destructive fuzzing, parameter injection probes, timing anomalies, error message analysis.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements, ORM abstraction, validate input against strict allowlists.

summary: Risks related to design flaws and missing threat modeling.
detection_strategy: Review authentication workflows, rate-limiting on sensitive endpoints, credential recovery flows.
remediation: Implement secure design patterns, multi-factor authentication, threat modeling, and defense-in-depth.

summary: Default accounts, unnecessary enabled features, missing security headers, open cloud storage.
detection_strategy: Inspect HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS), default ports, debug flags.
remediation: Harden systems with automated baselines, remove unused packages, configure secure HTTP response headers.
